title: Scope numeric conservation dice tokens per variant/clause
description: Follow-up from eshyra-jjti: numericConservationFindings currently pools parent and all variant mechanics in mechanicsTokens, so a sibling variant or unrelated effect can satisfy another prose dice token. Refactor the SRD magic-item numeric conservation gate to compare tokens within the relevant variant/clause scope, preserving exact-token matching and scoped exceptions. Add synthetic cross-variant regression coverage and adjudicate any newly exposed committed-pack findings against SRD source.
notes: Implemented parent/per-variant dice-token conservation scopes with scoped exceptions and synthetic sibling-variant regression. Committed pack exposes no new findings; regeneration verification has zero generated changes.
